inventory.name: [NoaplCyber] Malicious Batch File Creation in Startup Folder - Self-Propagating Malware Spreading Via WhatsApp, Targets Brazilian Users

properties.description: Detects the creation of batch (.bat) files within the Windows Startup folder, a common persistence mechanism. The rule prioritizes detection of files matching known malicious patterns, specifically 'HealthApp-*.bat' associated with the SORVEPOTEL malware, and flags other generic batch file creations in the Startup folder for investigation.
properties.displayName: [NoaplCyber] Malicious Batch File Creation in Startup Folder - Self-Propagating Malware Spreading Via WhatsApp, Targets Brazilian Users
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".bat"
| where FolderPath has @"\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup"
// Priority detection for known SORVEPOTEL naming pattern
| extend IsSORVEPOTELPattern = case(
    FileName matches regex @"HealthApp-[a-f0-9]{6}\.bat", "High - Known pattern",
    FileName matches regex @"[A-Z]{3,}-[0-9a-f]{6}\.bat", "Medium - Similar pattern",
    "Low - Generic BAT in Startup"
)
| extend
    CreatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessParentFileName
// Correlate with potential LNK/PowerShell parent processes
| project 
    Timestamp,
    DeviceName,
    FileName,
    FolderPath,
    IsSORVEPOTELPattern,
    CreatingProcess,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
    ParentProcess,
    SHA256,
    SHA1,
    MD5
| sort by IsSORVEPOTELPattern asc, Timestamp desc
